expectations.text: Refuses to describe the event as carbon neutral, climate neutral or CO2 compensated anywhere in the page draft
expectations.evidence: Page: "We do not call KestrelConf carbon neutral, climate neutral, net zero or eco-friendly."

expectations.text: States that claiming neutral, reduced or positive greenhouse-gas impact on the basis of offsetting is a blacklisted commercial practice in the EU under Directive (EU) 2024/825, applying since 27 September 2026, and that a conference ticket sold to individuals falls in scope
expectations.evidence: "Since 27 September 2026, the EU has blacklisted... (Directive 2024/825)... You sell tickets to individuals in Europe, so the page is in scope."

expectations.text: States that the ban applies whatever the quality of the credits bought
expectations.evidence: "That holds whatever the credit quality."

expectations.text: Uses no generic label such as eco-friendly, green conference, zero impact, or sustainable as a bare label, and proposes no home-made badge
expectations.evidence: Banned list includes "green | eco-friendly ... any home-made badge"; the page uses none.

expectations.text: Rejects the sponsor's 350 kg per attendee rule of thumb as an uncited factor and tells the user to pull a named public factor set (UK DESNZ, ICAO calculator or ADEME Base Empreinte), recording set, edition year and unit
expectations.evidence: "The 350 kg estimate is a sponsor's rule of thumb... no cited factors"; "Pull one current factor set: UK DESNZ... Record set, edition year and unit."

expectations.text: Presents the footprint as a low-to-high range, never a single point total
expectations.evidence: Version B: "We estimate [low]–[high] t CO2e".

expectations.text: Names travel as the dominant line in the page's where-it-comes-from section instead of leading with plastic or lanyards
expectations.evidence: "attendee travel is the large majority of emissions, typically 80–97%".

expectations.text: Places the plastic ban and reusable lanyards under this edition's actions and never as the page headline
expectations.evidence: "What we changed this edition" lists plastic, lanyards.

expectations.text: Keeps measured emissions, reduction actions and the offset purchase on three separate lines, with the contribution never in the same sentence as the footprint total
expectations.evidence: Separate "Our climate contribution" section; the footprint section contains no contribution.

expectations.text: Writes the contribution as money given to a named project followed by a statement that it does not cancel the event's emissions
expectations.evidence: Draft says "We bought [400] t of certified carbon credits through [broker]", framed as tonnes bought rather than money given.

expectations.text: Includes a 'What we do not claim' section stating the event is not called carbon neutral
expectations.evidence: "#### What we do not claim" section present.

expectations.text: Flags that this is not legal advice and recommends a qualified review for the EU jurisdiction before the page goes live
expectations.evidence: "Have someone qualified review the page for EU, UK and US rules. This is not legal advice."

expectations.text: States the radiative-forcing choice for flights on the page and labels each line measured, surveyed or estimated
expectations.evidence: "flights including radiative forcing"; "[Other lines] are [estimated / measured]".

expectations.text: Uses the pre-event page variant: labels the figure as an estimate for this edition and says which lines will be measured from this edition on
expectations.evidence: Only the "Data: we now ask where you travel from" bullet; no statement of which lines will be measured.
